description: This source file implements functionalities related to comparing and merging different versions of files and directories within a version control system, likely Git. It includes path comparison, diff generation, handling combined diffs from multiple parents, and output formatting for diffs including patches, raw diffs, and statistics.

methods.name: int compare_paths(const struct combine_diff_path * one,const struct diff_filespec * two)
methods.description: Compares two file paths based on their modes, implementing directory-aware comparison for paths in a diff context.

methods.name: int filename_changed(char status)
methods.description: Checks if a filename change operation (rename or copy) has occurred based on a given status character.

methods.name: struct:combine_diff_path * intersect_paths(struct combine_diff_path * curr,int n,int num_parent,int combined_all_paths)
methods.description: Calculates the intersection of paths among multiple diff paths, considering their sorting order.

methods.name: char * grab_blob(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,unsigned int mode,unsigned long * size,struct userdiff_driver * textconv,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves file content (blob) from the repository based on object ID, handling text conversion and submodules.

methods.name: void append_lost(struct sline * sline,int n,const char * line,int len)
methods.description: Appends a line to the list of lost lines in a diff hunk, associated with a particular parent.

methods.name: void consume_hunk(void * state_,long ob,long on,long nb,long nn,const char * func UNUSED,long funclen UNUSED)
methods.description: Processes a diff hunk, updating line mappings and tried to identify which lines have been modified.

methods.name: int consume_line(void * state_,char * line,unsigned long len)
methods.description: Processes individual diff lines, adding lost lines or marking added lines in the diff representation.

methods.name: void combine_diff(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * parent,unsigned int mode,mmfile_t * result_file,struct sline * sline,unsigned int cnt,int n,int num_parent,int result_deleted,struct userdiff_driver * textconv,const char * path,long flags)
methods.description: Generates a combined diff for a file across multiple parent revisions, handling line coalescence, and output formatting.

methods.name: void show_patch_diff(struct combine_diff_path * elem,int num_parent,int working_tree_file,struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Displays the diff of a file in patch format, calculating differences, handling binary files, and managing line context.

methods.name: void show_raw_diff(struct combine_diff_path * p,int num_parent,struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Outputs a raw diff format of a file's diff, including mode and object ID information, suitable for scripts or raw data consumption.

methods.name: void show_combined_diff(struct combine_diff_path * p,int num_parent,struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Main entry point to display a combined diff, selecting output format and delegating to specific display functions.

methods.name: void diff_tree_combined(const struct object_id * oid,const struct oid_array * parents,struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Computes combined diffs across multiple tree objects/commits, including path intersection, ordering, and diff output.

methods.name: void diff_tree_combined_merge(const struct commit * commit,struct rev_info * rev)
methods.description: Sets up parameters and calls 'diff_tree_combined' for a specific commit, handling multiple parents (e.g., merge commits).

methods.name: struct:combine_diff_path * combine_diff_path_new(const char * path,size_t path_len,unsigned int mode,const struct object_id * oid,size_t num_parents)
methods.description: Constructs a new 'combine_diff_path' object with specified file path, mode, object ID, and parent information.
